crossRefs.note: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name will be Sarah.
Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:
Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of…

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Haran
people.line: Son of Terah, brother of Abraham and father of Lot.

people.name: Iscah
people.line: Daughter of Haran, Milcah's sister, Lot's sister.

people.name: Nahor
people.line: Son of Terah, Abraham's brother; father of Bethuel.

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.
translations.bsb: And Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves. Abram’s wife was named Sarai, and Nahor’s wife was named Milcah; she was the daughter of Haran, who was the father of both Milcah and Iscah.
translations.kjv: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
translations.asv: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: The name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
